title: PHU QUOC SOUTH AND NORTH ISLAND TOUR
summary: This full day private tour combines the most outstanding attractions of both the South and North of Phu Quoc Island .
children: Children under 5 years old: Free of charge.
html:
This full day private tour combines the most outstanding attractions of both the South and North of Phu Quoc Island.

On the way to the South, guests will visit a Pearl Farm to learn about the cultured pearl production process. The tour continues to a local Pepper Farm, where visitors can discover different types of peppercorns used in Vietnamese cuisine, followed by a visit to the Sim Wine Factory to learn how local fruit wine is produced.

The journey continues with a scenic drive up to Ho Quoc Pagoda, offering peaceful surroundings and panoramic views. Guests will then relax and swim at Bai Sao Beach.

In the afternoon, the tour includes a visit to the Coconut Tree Prison, a historical site related to wartime history, and a traditional Fish Sauce Factory to see how the famous “Nuoc Mam” fish sauce is made.

Guests may enjoy light trekking at Tranh Stream Waterfall (seasonal) or choose to visit Sunset Town, featuring the Clock Tower and Kiss Bridge (optional, entrance fee at own expense).

In the North of the island, the tour continues with a stop at a Bee Farm to taste local honey, followed by light walking inside Phu Quoc National Park. Guests will then relax and swim at Starfish Beach in Rach Vem Village, admire the view of Cambodia from Ganh Dau Cape, and unwind at Bai Dai Beach. The tour also includes a visit to the Grand World entertainment complex.

DETAILED ITINERARY

SOUTH ISLAND

08:45 – 09:00

Hotel pickup in Duong Dong Ward.

(For guests staying outside Duong Dong, please contact us in advance.)

Pearl Farm – Learn about pearl harvesting and cultivation.

Sim Wine Factory – Discover local fruit wine production.

Pepper Farm – Visit a local pepper garden.

Ho Quoc Pagoda – Scenic uphill drive and panoramic sea views.

Bai Sao Beach – Relax, swim, and sunbathe.
(Lunch included if the tour with lunch option is booked.)

Coconut Tree Prison – Visit a historical wartime site.

Fish Sauce Factory – Learn about traditional fish sauce production.

Tranh Stream Waterfall – Light trekking experience.
(Not available during the rainy season from May to October.)

Optional visit to Sunset Town – Clock Tower and Kiss Bridge.
(Entrance ticket at guests’ own expense.)

NORTH ISLAND

Rach Vem Village – Starfish Beach for swimming and relaxation.

Light forest walking in Phu Quoc National Park.

Check-in at Grand World Phu Quoc entertainment center.

17:00
Return to hotel.

LUNCH OPTIONS

Guests may choose one lunch location:

Bai Sao Beach

Rach Vem Village

Ganh Dau Beach

DROP-OFF OPTIONS (OPTIONAL)

The tour may end at one of the following locations:

South Island – Sunset Town (Clock Tower and Kiss Bridge)

North Island – Grand World Entertainment Theme Center

Entrance tickets and return transportation are arranged and paid by guests.

TOUR INCLUDES

Private air-conditioned vehicle with driver.

English-speaking tour guide.

One bottle of water per guest.

Special meal requests such as vegan, vegetarian, or children’s meals must be informed at the time of booking or at least 24 hours before departure.

TOUR EXCLUDES

Personal expenses.

Entrance tickets for optional attractions.

CHILDREN’S PRICING POLICY

Children under 5 years old: Free of charge.

Children from 5 to 9 years old: 50% of adult price.

Children aged 10 and above: Adult price.

(Age is based on year of birth.)

PAYMENT POLICY

Groups of 1 to 5 guests:

50% deposit upon booking.

Remaining balance paid no later than one day before or on the tour day.

Groups of 6 guests or more:

50% deposit upon booking.

Remaining balance paid no later than one day before the tour date.

CANCELLATION POLICY

Groups of 1 to 5 guests:

Cancellation one day before the tour date: No charge.

Cancellation on the tour date: 100% of tour value charged.

Groups of 6 guests or more:

Cancellation two days before the tour date: No charge.

Cancellation one day before the tour date: 50% of tour value charged.

Cancellation on the tour date: 100% of tour value charged.

Weather-related cancellations:

If the Port Authority does not allow the tour to operate, Vietlook Travel will cancel the tour and provide a full refund.

If the tour is permitted to operate but guests choose to cancel, no refund will be provided.

IMPORTANT NOTES

Guests wishing to stop at Sunset Sanato or Duong Dong Night Market should inform the tour guide in advance. Entrance tickets and return transportation are at guests’ own expense.

Please bring towels, swimwear, spare clothes, comfortable shoes or flip-flops, sunscreen, and some cash.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible for any lost, misplaced, or stolen items.

HEALTH AND SAFETY

This tour is not recommended for guests with limited mobility or wheelchair users.

Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult a doctor before joining the tour.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible for any health-related issues during the tour.
